# Description

A small addon that focuses on exporting the in-game guild roster to various formats. Just open up the options by clicking the minimap button, select your format and do an export!

## Features

- Export all 17 columns of the guild roster, plus 2 additional ones that are specific to this addon.
- Extensive settings for how the export will be done.
- Select which columns to export.
- Custom column names.
- Able to sort the roster. Select 2 columns to sort by, and which sort order to use (ascending or descending).
- Select which guild ranks to export.
- Choose which type of indentation to use: tabs or spaces.
- Supports [minification](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minification_(programming)) for select formats.
- Automatic export to the saved variables file, for external extraction. (requires logging out/reload UI to be saved).
- Each format have their own settings.

### Supported formats
- CSV
- HTML*
- JSON*
- MD (Markdown)
- XML*
- YAML*

\* [Minification](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minification_(programming)) available.

### Slash commands
- `/guildrosterexport` - Toggle options.
- `/guildrosterexport help` - Print help.
- `/guildrosterexport export [file format]` - Do an export. The export frame will open.

### Columns
- name*
- rankName*
- rankIndex*
- level*
- class*
- zone
- note
- officerNote
- isOnline
- status
- classFileName
- achievementPoints
- achievementRank
- isMobile
- isSoREligible
- repStandingID
- GUID
- lastOnline**
- realmName**

\* Selected by default.\
\*\* Additional columns that are specific to this addon.

# GuildRosterExport

## [2.2.1] - 2026-11-07
[View full changelog](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/blob/master/CHANGELOG-FULL.md) | [View code](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/tree/2.2.1) | [View commits](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/compare/2.2.0...2.2.1) | [Previous releases](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/releases)

### Changed
- \[Forever\] Column "realmName" will now be empty.
- \[Forever\] Hide option to remove realm name from character name.
- Register with Addon Compartment in other clients than Retail. Requires that the Addon Compartment is available in the client.
- Updated library Ace3 to version r1424 alpha. This version contains AceDB-3.0 r40 which has better support for profiles in Forever. 

**NB!** Everyone who used version 2.2.0 in Forever will get a new profile when they log in but the old one is still available to copy from!

# GuildRosterExport

## [2.2.0] - 2026-11-05
[View full changelog](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/blob/master/CHANGELOG-FULL.md) | [View code](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/tree/2.2.0) | [View commits](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/compare/2.1.5...2.2.0) | [Previous releases](https://github.com/CruelDrool/GuildRosterExport/releases)

### Fixed
- Sorting settings: dropdown values for "Primary column" and "Secondary column" will now update after column names have been changed.
- Localizations will now be sorted after their translated names.

### Added
- Support for WoW Forever.
- Export to a Markdown (MD) table.
	- Select style and column alignment.
- Support for fonts through [LibSharedMedia-3.0](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libsharedmedia-3-0).
	- Options for fonts added. Select name, size, [flags](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/API_types/TBFFlags), and color.
	- The font "Roboto Mono Regular" has been added but is only available for western languages and Russian.
	- Preview fonts using [AceGUI-3.0-SharedMediaWidgets](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/ace-gui-3-0-shared-media-widgets)
- New option: "Load fonts from LibSharedMedia when logging in or reloading UI". This prevents blank entries in the dropdown for fonts.

### Changed
- Updated library LibDBIcon-1.0 to version 12.1.2 (r167)
- Updated test rosters.
- Updated enUS localization.
